description: Mobile onboarding responsive audit and fixes. The OnboardingScreen.tsx already uses Math.min() patterns for responsive sizing. Verify and fix any remaining issues: ensure no horizontal scrolling (FlatList pagingEnabled with width: SCREEN_WIDTH should prevent this), no vertical overflow on small devices, safe area respected on screen 3 (has SafeAreaView), Nepal flag scales correctly (already uses Math.min(140, SCREEN_WIDTH * 0.35)), and dots are positioned safely above bottom safe area.
steps: 1. In mobile/src/screens/onboarding/OnboardingScreen.tsx, verify that the FlatList uses getItemLayout to optimize rendering and prevent scrolling jitter on low-end devices

2. Verify screen 3 (Get Started) benefits list doesn't overflow on small screens (320px width Android devices). The benefitsContainer may need a maxHeight or ScrollView wrapper for very small screens.

3. Ensure the dots container (position: absolute, bottom) doesn't overlap with home indicator on newer devices - add SafeAreaView or extra bottom padding. Current bottom: Math.min(40, SCREEN_HEIGHT * 0.05) should be adequate for most devices.
4. Add getItemLayout to FlatList for better scroll performance: getItemLayout={(_, index) => ({ length: SCREEN_WIDTH, offset: SCREEN_WIDTH * index, index })}
5. Wrap screens 1 and 2 in SafeAreaView like screen 3 to ensure status bar area is respected on all slides
6. Verify landscape handling - since AndroidManifest has screenOrientation='portrait', landscape is locked out. No landscape fixes needed.
acceptance_criteria: FlatList has getItemLayout for optimized scroll performance
All three slides use SafeAreaView to respect safe areas
No overflow on 320px width devices (benefits list wraps properly)
Dot indicators don't overlap home indicator area
No horizontal scrolling issues (pagingEnabled with exact SCREEN_WIDTH)
Nepal flag renders proportionally with Math.min pattern
verification: Read mobile/src/screens/onboarding/OnboardingScreen.tsx and verify SafeAreaView usage on all slides
Verify getItemLayout is added to FlatList
findings: All changes verified via AST-level code inspection (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode prevents actual builds). Added getItemLayout to FlatList for scroll perf. Wrapped slides 1 and 2 in SafeAreaView with new slideSafeArea style. Increased dots bottom from 40/5% to 52/6.5% to clear home indicator on modern devices. Added flexShrink:1 and overflow:hidden to benefitsContainer for small screen safety. All Math.min() responsive patterns preserved. Landscape is locked via AndroidManifest screenOrientation=portrait.
